name: modder
description: One orchestrator over every Claude Code session you have open, with Jev (TypeSafe System One) deciding which one needs you

jevMode.title: Jev mode
jevMode.description: off: no Jev calls. shadow (default): Jev's answers are logged and shown, nothing is enforced. enforce: the permission gate acts on Jev's verdicts.

keyFile.title: OpenRouter key file
keyFile.description: A file that holds your OpenRouter API key, read at runtime and never shown. Leave empty to use the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable.

protect.title: Protected paths
protect.description: Comma-separated path fragments that no tool call may touch, in any mode. Calls that touch them are denied in code and never sent to Jev.

denyPushFrom.title: Never push from
denyPushFrom.description: Comma-separated directories where git push is always denied (for example a stale clone).
